why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft, the icon opens a small page next to it

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Changed
- The floating report icon: a click now opens a SMALL page stuck to the icon, not a window in the middle. It says what the report helps with (for example 2 NPC names, 3 quest texts, 11 spells and buffs), has a box with the report and three buttons: copy report, site address, clear. The page opens to the side of the icon that has room, and closes when the icon is clicked again, dragged or hidden. An addon can not write to the clipboard or open a web page, so the copy buttons select the text and the player presses Ctrl+C.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- Buffs that never reached the report are found now (short descriptions, other tooltip paths).
- The game windows switch is OFF by default.
- Floating report icon with a one-time intro, the switch on top of Settings > Status and report.
- Auction house without the English flash and with its own switch. Second report texts in Persian.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat.
